findings.text: The shipped splitter misses sentence endings followed by a closing quote and Unicode ellipses, allowing multiple sentences to merge and the six-sentence cap to undercount.
findings.fix: Extend the deterministic split rule to recognize closing punctuation after terminators and `…`, with binding boundary tests for both forms.

findings.text: The reviewer cold read scored 6/8, so Acceptance 3's explicit requirement that both role-specific own/not-own runs score 8/8 is unmet regardless of reviewer.md being untouched or the result being a single sample.
findings.fix: Disambiguate the reviewer contract for the two missed classes and rerun the prescribed cold read until the recorded reviewer-side result satisfies 8/8.

findings.text: The abbreviation allow-list excludes forms such as `U.S.`, so the cap can overcount one grammatical sentence as two.
findings.fix: Add the supported dotted-abbreviation handling and a regression case for `U.S.`.

verdicts.notes: Reproduced both undercounts directly. Semicolon-chain escape is real but plan Risk 4 accepts it. count=0 mutation change verified as not a weakening. Could not run pytest in the read-only sandbox (no writable tmp).

findings.text: "their mutation-count helper is fixed to count sentences dropped, not words" misdescribes the W1-02 fix, which changed re.sub(..., count=1) to count=0 in _mutate_paragraph (test_probes_positioning_branch_end.py:216) so every occurrence of a duplicated drop-token is deleted; nothing in that fix counts sentences vs words.
findings.fix: Rewrite CHANGELOG bullet 3 to describe the actual fix: the helper now deletes every occurrence of the dropped token, not just the first, so a token that appears twice cannot leave a surviving occurrence that masks the mutant.

findings.text: _sentences() (test_review_station_text.py:97) undercounts: a sentence ending ." or … is not split by (?<=[.!?])\s+, silently merging two sentences, so SENTENCE_CAP=6 can be exceeded without the check firing — reproduced by running the strict-xfail probe (32 passed, 3 xfailed).
findings.fix: Extend the terminator class to include closing quotes after terminators and …, then flip the two xfail markers to real assertions.

verdicts.notes: Acceptance 3 reader-side 6/8 read as single-sample cold-read noise on unchanged prose (prior change reached 8/8 on two consecutive samples of the same paragraph; intent keeps reader text out of scope) — a ship-gate/user-acceptance question, not a finding against this lens. count=1→count=0 verified as a strengthening. Full suite 1234 passed reproduced.

open_findings.text: _sentences() treats neither ." (terminator then closing quote) nor … as a sentence end; two sentences merge and SENTENCE_CAP undercounts.
Reviewer-side cold read own/not-own 6/8 against Acceptance 3's 8/8 (reviewer.md untouched by this delta; sonnet reader reads it as single-sample noise — disagreement recorded, not averaged).
